title: Harbor ferry terminal weekly operations note (synthetic)
sentences: The harbor ferry terminal issued this operations note for the week of 14 September 2026.
Ferries completed 312 crossings and carried 18,400 passengers.
Ticket gates logged 17,950 boardings, while the crew counts total 18,400.
Wait times at the north ramp were not recorded because the counter failed.
A vendor claims its new turnstiles would cut boarding time by 25 percent.
